JOB DESCRIPTION – INTERIOR DESIGNER\*

\*Position:\* Interior Designer

\*Location:\* Chennai, Tamil Nadu

\*Project Location:\* Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu

\*Experience:\* 3–6+ Years

\*Joining:\* Immediate Joiner Preferred

\*Employment Type:\* Full-Time

\*Travel:\* Willingness to travel across Tamil Nadu as required

### Job Summary

We are looking for a \* Interior Designer based in Chennai\* with strong practical knowledge of \*interior design as well as construction and site execution\*.

The candidate will be responsible for our upcoming project in \*Thoothukudi\* and will also support other projects across Tamil Nadu. This role requires someone who is comfortable working at project sites, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and ensuring that designs are properly executed on site.

We are specifically looking for a candidate with \*hands-on site experience\*, rather than someone whose experience is limited to design or office-based work.

### Key Responsibilities

\* Handle interior design and execution activities for the Thoothukudi project and other Tamil Nadu projects.

\* Coordinate with clients, architects, structural/MEP consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

\* Review and understand architectural and interior drawings before execution.

\* Prepare/review detailed interior drawings, layouts, elevations, sections, and working drawings.

\* Supervise interior works at site and ensure execution as per approved drawings and specifications.

\* Monitor false ceiling, flooring, partitions, carpentry, furniture, painting, electrical, lighting, plumbing, and other interior works.

\* Check measurements, materials, finishes, samples, and workmanship.

\* Coordinate with contractors and vendors for timely completion of works.

\* Identify site issues and coordinate with the concerned teams for practical solutions.

\* Conduct regular site inspections and provide progress updates to management.

\* Monitor quality, timelines, and proper execution of interior works.

\* Assist in material selection, procurement requirements, and vendor coordination.

\* Verify quantities and measurements related to interior works.

\* Maintain proper records of drawings, revisions, measurements, material approvals, and site progress.

\* Coordinate with the project team to ensure smooth execution from design stage through completion.

\* Travel to project sites across Tamil Nadu whenever required.

### Required Skills & Qualifications

\* B.Arch / B.Des / Diploma in Interior Design or relevant qualification.

\* Relevant experience in \*interior design and site execution\*.

\* Strong practical understanding of construction and interior finishing works.

\* Good knowledge of materials, finishes, furniture, false ceiling, flooring, partitions, lighting, and related works.

\* Ability to read and understand architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.

\* Proficiency in \*AutoCAD\* and other relevant design software.

\* Knowledge of SketchUp, 3D software, or Revit will be an added advantage.

\* Strong site coordination and problem-solving skills.

\* Excellent \*English communication skills\*, both written and verbal.

\* Ability to communicate professionally with clients, architects, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

\* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.

\* Willingness to travel extensively across Tamil Nadu as required.

### Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

\* Experienced in both \*design and actual site execution\*.

\* Practical, proactive, and capable of independently handling site-related requirements.

\* Comfortable coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

\* Good in communication and professional relationship management.

\* Willing to travel to \*Thoothukudi and other project locations across Tamil Nadu\*.

\* \*Immediate joiner or candidate with a short notice period preferred.\*

\*Location:\* Chennai, with travel to Thoothukudi and other project sites across Tamil Nadu.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month
